description: Source code for a class named Analyzer that processes JSON input to analyze dependencies among build targets, files, and configurations in a build system. It includes methods for parsing JSON, filtering targets, and determining affected items based on file modifications.

classes.name: Inputs
classes.description: Holds input data parsed from JSON, including source files, compile and test labels, and flags.

classes.name: Outputs
classes.description: Holds output data for JSON serialization, including status, error messages, and target labels.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Main method that takes JSON input, performs dependency analysis, and returns JSON output.

methods.name: GetAllAffectedItems
methods.description: Returns all items affected by changes in specified source files.

methods.name: InvalidLabels
methods.description: Filters out labels that do not correspond to known items.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters targets to exclude groups, including dependencies.

methods.name: FilterTarget
methods.description: Recursively filters a target and its dependencies.

methods.name: ItemRefersToFile
methods.description: Checks if an item refers to a specific source file.

methods.name: AddItemsDirectlyReferringToFile
methods.description: Adds items directly referring to a given file to a set.

methods.name: AddAllItemsReferringToItem
methods.description: Recursively adds items referring to a given item.

methods.name: WereMainGNFilesModified
methods.description: Checks if main GN files or dependencies were modified.
